scope: Static inspection of two public download artifacts and source-only local TUI context; no execution, host/API/SSH access, credentials, or service changes.

local_tui_source.provenance_limit: Source-only context; no source-to-downloaded-binary correspondence was established.

findings.claim: The inspected installer automatically attempts machine registration.
The inspected installer conditionally launches a self-test after a machine ID and successful speed-test output; its parser contains no self-test-disable or public-rental/listing-prevention flag.
Automatic public listing is not established by this static inspection.
findings.limit: Dynamically obtained update/self-test components were not inspected.

findings.claim: No documented safe real-install no-public-rental mode was found; TUI source cannot pass such a control.
The local TUI source is not proven to correspond to the downloaded binary.
evidence: downloaded TUI SHA-256 and static file metadata only

findings.claim: The stock installer/TUI cannot guarantee the authorized initial-publication prices, expiry bound, or no-reboot constraint.
limits: Self-test positional value units and semantics are not defined by the inspected script.
Dynamic downstream components were not inspected.

residual_risks: Unpinned dynamically retrieved update, machine-information, and self-test components.
Unknown semantics of self-test positional arguments.
No stock-path guarantee of authorized prices, offer end time, or no reboot.
authorization: No installation, registration, self-test, listing, public rental, workload, or readiness claim is authorized by this evidence.
